apps.name: Planner 3
apps.subtitle: A calm to-do list that syncs through your own Google Drive.
apps.localizedDescription: Planner 3: Today, Upcoming, projects and areas, reminders with your own tune, and your calendar events. Syncs with the Android and web apps through your own Google Drive.
